title: Investigation by the Department upon its own motion as to the propriety of the request for approval of the rate schedule MDPU No. 796 allowing for the imposition of a 2% rate surcharge on all customers in any municipality which mandates the replacement of overhead facilities with underground facilities. The rate schedule is being filed by Boston Edison Company, pursuant to G.L. c. 166, § 22L. Effective January 1, 1991, it will apply to certain facilities in the Town of Needham. Also for approval are amended copies of all of the Company's existing rate schedules, revised to include a reference to the new schedule MDPU No. 796.
filings: Letter from Douglas Horan, The Company is withdrawing its May 1, 1990 filing and its request for rate schedule approval. (90-128) Therefore Docket closed per 220 CMR 1.04(4)
